% labelled along its own arc; the stated limitation sits at the centre.

  party/.style={text width=5.1cm, minimum height=5.35cm, align=left, inner sep=5pt, font=\scriptsize},
]
\begin{scope}[on background layer]
  \draw[gold, line width=0.4pt, opacity=0.55] (90:7.90) -- (210:7.90) -- (330:7.90) -- cycle;

\node[layerbox, party, text=white] (p90) at (90:7.90) {{\bfseries\small Issuing authority}\\[1pt]{\itshape the schema, the signing key, the epoch roots, the status}\\[4pt]\textbf{records, zero-knowledge mode:} an event with no token identifier (C2)\\[2pt]\textbf{records, online status check:} no who-verified-whom row\\[2pt]\textbf{cannot:} rebuild the zero-knowledge verification graph from its own database};
\node[humanbox, party, text=navydark] (p210) at (210:7.90) {{\bfseries\small Holder}\\[1pt]{\itshape the wallet holds a file: token value, signature, issuer key; optionally a stapled status assertion, a membership proof, a presentation code}\\[4pt]\textbf{sees:} its own credential\\[2pt]\textbf{decides:} the disclosure level it presents under\\[2pt]\textbf{cannot:} upgrade what the server will record (C6)};
\node[extbox, party, text=navydark] (p330) at (330:7.90) {{\bfseries\small Relying party}\\[1pt]{\itshape runs the detached verifier or an SDK, offline; or calls the issuer as itself}\\[4pt]\textbf{checks, offline:} authentic; issuer trusted; assertion bound, fresh, ACTIVE; context\\[2pt]\textbf{learns:} a valid credential exists; the credential value\\[2pt]\textbf{cannot:} reach the person's record; verify authorization fresher than the assertion};

The login token's subject is no longer that value: since \code{v9.353} it is derived per relying party. Unlinkability is issuer-side and scoped to zero-knowledge mode; cross-verifier unlinkability on a plain presentation is not implemented, by design.};
